summary: Full E2E frontend testing of Questing Academy MVP. Tested: Landing, Onboarding (K/1/2), Character Creator (avatar, swatches, randomize, name validation), Starter Picker (3 companions, disabled state), Hub (4 tiles, topbar chips), Battle (moves, math question, correct/wrong answer feedback with damage, victory flow with rewards), Egg page (progress bars, both eggs), Collection, Academy (assign + unassign), Parent dashboard (wrong PIN error + correct PIN 1234 unlocks stats), localStorage persistence across reload, TopBar nav. 20/21 assertions passed. The single 'failure' (topbar-home-btn on Collection) is a test-assumption issue — TopBar shows EITHER back OR home (mutually exclusive by design), so Collection (which has back) correctly hides home.

issues: After answer feedback the UI auto-advances back to intro phase within ~1s; younger users may not have time to read the feedback message. Consider requiring tap-to-continue or longer dwell.

topbar-home-btn and topbar-back-btn are mutually exclusive. On sub-pages with back set (Collection, Academy, Egg, Battle, Parent) only back is shown. This is intentional but request spec implied both should be present; documenting as design note, not a bug.

action_items: Optional: Consider showing both back AND home on deeper pages so kids can jump to hub in one tap (currently they can only go back step-by-step from /battle->/hub via back-btn, which is fine since back routes to /hub).
Optional: Increase feedback dwell time in Battle so children can read the message before next turn auto-starts.
critical_code_review_comments: Battle.tsx: setTimeout-based phase transitions are functional but could leak if user navigates away mid-turn — consider clearing timeouts on unmount.
gameStore.ts persistence works; player + eggs + parent stats survive reload as verified.
Question pool is small per grade (6 questions per K/1/2) — fine for MVP but flagged in code TODO already.
React Router future-flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) appear in console — non-blocking but easy to silence by opting into the flags.
seed_data_creation: None — fresh localStorage cleared, player 'Mochi' (Grade K, Spriggle starter) created via real flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All happy-path flows work end-to-end. Battle correct/wrong answer damage logic verified (correct: 22 dmg full; wrong: 4 dmg reduced, with 'Right answer was X' hint). Egg progress increments on battle wins; Collection shows owned/locked; Academy assign/unassign toggles work; Parent PIN 1234 unlocks 4 stat cards. localStorage persistence verified by reload on /hub. TopBar back/home are mutually exclusive by design.
